description: Pradeshiya Sabha Giribawa - List of Roads of the Giribawa Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the declaration of roads and lanes as property owned by the Giribawa Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules of road coordinates, lengths, and widths, and addresses land ownership claims and property boundaries. The content focuses on land registration and property rights rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
